harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a 3-member etcd cluster (v3.4.30) across node1/node2/node3 via apt-installed etcd-server with static bootstrap discovery over their peer URLs. Verified cross-member consistency (write on node1, read confirmed on node2/node3), verified continued availability under a single-member outage (stopped node3, wrote/read successfully via node1+node2 at 2/3 quorum), and verified node3 fully caught up on rejoin. Then executed the mandatory one-at-a-time node restart protocol on all three nodes: captured a healthy baseline (boot_id + etcd active + data present) on each, issued a background-scheduled reboot on each node individually (quorum preserved throughout, never more than one node down), polled until reachable, confirmed a changed boot_id proving an actual reboot occurred, and confirmed etcd active, cluster membership at 3/3, endpoint health true for all endpoints, and prior keys readable post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected all three nodes (Ubuntu 24.04.3, no etcd preinstalled)
Installed etcd-server/etcd-client via apt on node1, node2, node3
Configured /etc/default/etcd on each node with ETCD_NAME, peer/client URLs, and identical ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER for static 3-member bootstrap
Started etcd on all three nodes; confirmed 3/3 members 'started' and healthy via etcdctl member list / endpoint health
Wrote key on node1, confirmed readable from node2 and node3
Stopped etcd on node3 to simulate member unavailability; wrote and read a key via node1/node2 while node3 was down, confirming quorum preserved
Restarted etcd on node3; confirmed it caught up on the key written during its downtime and cluster returned to 3/3 healthy
Captured pre-restart boot_id, etcd active state, and data presence on all three nodes as baseline
Rebooted node1 via backgrounded reboot command (ack returned before disconnect), polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, confirmed etcd active and 3/3 cluster health with data intact
Rebooted node2 the same way; confirmed new boot_id and full recovery
Rebooted node3 the same way; confirmed new boot_id and full recovery, with all cluster members and both test keys present

evidence.requirement: 3-member etcd cluster formed across node1/node2/node3
evidence.summary: etcdctl member list shows all 3 members (node1/node2/node3) with status 'started' and endpoint health true for all three client endpoints

evidence.requirement: Key written through any member is readable from the others
evidence.summary: Wrote benchmark-key via node1's endpoint, then read it successfully from node2's and node3's endpoints

evidence.requirement: Cluster keeps serving reads/writes while one member is unavailable
evidence.summary: Stopped etcd on node3, then successfully wrote 'during-outage' key via node1 and read it back via node2, with endpoint health true for the two remaining members

evidence.requirement: Unavailable member catches up when it returns
evidence.summary: Restarted etcd on node3; it reported active, then successfully returned the 'during-outage' key written while it was down, and all 3 members showed healthy

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id df9e2dce..., etcd ActiveState=active/SubState=running, and successful read of during-outage key on node1 before reboot

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged before disconnect; node1 unreachable during reboot; boot_id changed to 17d44014... confirming an actual restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: recovered state
evidence.summary: Post-reboot: etcd active, during-outage key readable, all 3 endpoints healthy, member list shows 3/3 started

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 37344ae4..., etcd active/running, and successful key read on node2 before reboot

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged before disconnect; node2 unreachable during reboot; boot_id changed to 6cf74869... confirming restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: recovered state
evidence.summary: Post-reboot: etcd active, during-outage key readable, all 3 endpoints healthy

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 92ec88af..., etcd active/running, and successful key read on node3 before reboot

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged before disconnect; node3 unreachable during reboot; boot_id changed to 371d3692... confirming restart

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: recovered state, full cluster and data integrity
evidence.summary: Post-reboot: etcd active, during-outage and benchmark-key both readable, all 3 endpoints healthy, member list 3/3 started
